visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a purple beanie and camouflage jacket stands inside a modern building with large wooden support beams, looking directly at the camera and speaking. (2) The scene cuts to a wide shot of a snowy mountain landscape under a clear blue sky, with several skiers visible on the slopes. (3) Back inside, the man points toward a red wall-mounted panel labeled 'Self-Service Repair Station' featuring various tools. (4) Close-up shots display a variety of red-handled screwdrivers and hex keys attached to the station by thin metal cables. (5) An overhead view from a cable car shows the Matterhorn peak and a mountain station in the background. (6) A wide shot shows a hallway with a large banner for 'Matterhorn Alpine Crossing' above a row of benches and bins. (7) A person is seen skateboarding in a sunny outdoor park, performing tricks in slow motion. (8) A hand reaches out to select and pull a T-handle hex key from the red tool station. (9) The man returns to the initial wooden-beam interior, smiling and waving goodbye to the camera.

(2) The background music maintains a steady 4/4 beat with light synth melodies, consistently ducked under the primary vocal level. (3) Subtle 'whoosh' sound effects are used to punctuate transitions between scenes, such as when switching from the indoor host segment to the snowy mountain B-roll. (4) The audio atmosphere remains clean and studio-processed, with minimal ambient noise interfering with the speech, which ends on a cheerful, high-pitch closing remark.
